text.Starbase Omega:
How to play ==
While Starbase Omega is in play, if you played a base this turn (including Starbase Omega), draw a card. Starbase Omega is a base with a defense of 6. 
 Strategy ==
This base is always self-replacing, since it draws a card in the turn in which it was played, meaning that it is never a bad card to have in your deck. If it is a strong card is a second question, and this depends on your deck. In a deck with many bases that is well scrapped, this card is very strong, as it can consistently trigger the draw ability. If your deck is not well scrapped it will often just draw up a Scout or Viper, which is not very useful. In that case, the abilities of the other bases in Year 1 Promos are often better. So compared to the other bases in Year 1 Promos, this card is usually stronger in late game, but less strong in early game or mid-game. However, it is often still a good idea to buy it when it appears, because this self-replacing card never hurts and will get more useful as the game progresses.
